name: diamond-memory
description: 钻石记忆系统 - 跨平台桌面应用

scripts.electron:build-all: npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:build-preload && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:build-preload && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:build-preload && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:build-preload && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "vite" "npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:build-preload && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
